events.title: SanDisk’s Latest Results Reset Expectations Again
events.body: Here’s a number that makes you look twice: in a single quarter, SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) generated nearly $3 billion in free cash flow, posted EPS of $23.41 vs estimates of $14.62, and then guided the next quarter to as much as $8.25 billion
